text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's just a few days to go until the
tryouts, where racers will
showcase their
abilities to potential trainers.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Wow, look at her go!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Panting...

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
That burst of acceleration was
breathtaking! I know I should wait for
the
tryouts, but I'm tempted to scout her here
and now.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr, huh? Her speed shows
the makings of a great
sprinter, but I
wouldn't get too hasty if I were you.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
From what I've heard, she doesn't have
much passion or ambition for
racing. It's
hard to get runners like that to push
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Zephyr! Nice to see you!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Why hello, Flower. As ever, your voice has
the lilt of petals in the
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It, um, it does? But thank you for the...
compliment?

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look who's here!
That's Nishino Flower.
She's a great runner too.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
She really is. It's always nice seeing a
student with so much motivation. Side by
side, you can see how passive Yamanin
Zephyr is
by comparison.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Um! You,
you don't need to listen to that
gossip. You only took a
break to take care
of your injury.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the reassurance. Personally,
though, it's only fair, given
that I haven't
run the tryouts yet.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's no use hoisting the sails if the
clouds are still. The trainers are still
judging whether I'll bring a weak
breath of wind or a powerful
blast. I can't fault them for that.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, I don't know how you always keep
such a level head! I guess it
gave those
trainers the wrong idea about you, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I have so much respect for the way you're
able to keep calm in any
situation!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Sweet as the scent of blossoms on a
spring breeze. Rest
assured, I am not
bothered by the trainers' assessment.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Teio's here to run.
I'll bet she's doing
some final checks before
the big day.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Pardon me, the tailwind urges me
toward the current. I'm terribly
sorry to cut
this short, but I must be away.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wait, Zephyr?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah! Sweet, I'm in top form!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the wind kicking up with your
every step—crisp and clear as a gale
through the hills. Please,
allow me to join
the current.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not gonna lie, that made zero sense,
but...
you're basically asking to
run with me.
Rrright?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Right.
I will engulf your gale and direct the
winds as my own grander
zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Now you're talkin' my language! I always like a little competition. Now—think you can keep up with this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two surge forward, overtaking one
another back and forth as they
push faster
and faster ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, with no clear finish line,
it's hard
to call a victor. The pair
eventually slow to
a stop together.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Panting... Whew. Guess that's a tie, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Panting... It seems so.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And I'm sorry to have barged in on your
practice run. I got swept away
when I saw
you, and couldn't help but challenge you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nah, it's all good. Why me, though?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just as you aspire to the Emperor's
grandeur, I too follow a great
slipstream...
to become a wind strong enough to reach
the sky's highest heavens.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
When I saw how high your spirit soared, I
felt the need to overcome
it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh... 'kay? So like, you're aiming to be
the top runner and don't
want to lose to
anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't really get all the metaphorical
stuff, but I totally get what you
mean! But
watch out, 'cause you're not beating the
one-and-only Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's determination written all over
Yamanin Zephyr's face. Then,
our eyes
meet.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A rival? That's like saying you saw a
tropical storm in the dead of
winter. I don't
think that Teio and I are comparable, let
alone rivals.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough, she'll take on the Classic
Triple Crown and fulfill the grand
expectations of her. And then there's me,
who hasn't even
debuted yet.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention that I'm a miler, so you're
about as likely to catch the
wind as see us
in a proper race together. As a trainer,
don't you see that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that the two will likely
compete in different races, without
much overlap, if
any. But that's not to say they can't be
rivals. After all...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...You really aren't like the other
trainers.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You and Flower both. You're willing to
wait for the wind to pick back up. I'm no
weather vane to tell you when that may
be, but... I don't anticipate bad weather
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I cannot think how to repay the
gratitude I feel for your support, but
if you would be
so kind as to watch my tryout race,
I think I can show you who I am.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I will run fast—faster than anyone else.
Fast enough that my heart and
spirit will
be the wind itself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Days later, the tryouts commence—without
Yamanin Zephyr.
